intent_contract.text: 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여
첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

The requester asks independent arms to author random complex concepts and use the supplied image to test actual visible realization. This arm independently chooses an intimate botanical salon portrait at the threshold between a living night greenhouse and its dry specimen archive. The assigned broad stage is coordinator-owned. The lowering action, begonia, garnet/ivory palette, hime cut, cat-ear headband, petticoat, and lace-up bodice are agent-owned choices, not requester definitions. The central experience is a warm human presence interrupting a cool cataloguing space; attraction is a subtle supporting quality at the saved sensual=1, with fetish=0 and surreal=0. The face uses only observable reference appearance; fictional adult age, hair, wardrobe, body, role, and expression are invented. WHO: a visibly poised fictional adult amid her own styling. WHERE: life and preservation share one threshold. HOW: a nearby eye-level viewer receives her calm camera acknowledgment. WHY NOW: the pot is caught just before reaching the low trolley shelf. A still pressed leaf gives the living transfer its immediate visible counterpart. These artistic choices remain editable on open dimensions.

A complex editorial photograph catches a single photographic moment in a night greenhouse adjoining a specimen archive. A fictional adult woman dressed for an after-hours botanical salon lowers a small flowering begonia toward a wheeled specimen trolley; the supplied portrait guides her visible facial appearance, including softly rounded facial contours, dark rounded almond eyes, a softly shaped nose, and full bowed lips. Her own invented styling has a hime cut: straight black hair with blunt jaw-length sidelocks ending sharply beside both cheeks, a straight eyebrow-level fringe, and a distinct longer back layer falling below her shoulders. A slim black headband arcs across her crown and carries two triangular felt cat ears as a wearable accessory. She wears a garnet satin dress with a square neckline. Two opposed vertical rows of metal eyelets frame the bodice opening, a black cord threads repeatedly across the opening in clear X-shaped crossings and ends in a small tied bow. The knee-length outer skirt flares over a separate gathered ivory petticoat; the petticoat's layered ruffled hem visibly extends below the satin hem and supports its rounded volume. Her left palm supports the pot's saucer while her right fingers steady the terracotta side; the pot stays beside her left thigh, just above the trolley's low shelf, leaving the bodice front readable. Her feet rest on the level aisle, her torso stays comfortably upright, and she turns her face toward the camera with a quiet, inviting expression. A dry pressed leaf on an archival sheet lies on the trolley near the living plant. Glass-front storage shelves recede behind her, roof trusses frame the dark night sky, and broad greenhouse leaves occupy the far edge. A warm task lamp gives the face and satin gentle lustre against cool teal archive light. An eye-level, head-to-toe vertical composition keeps her facial appearance, separated hair lengths, headband construction, lacing, and both skirt layers readable, with natural photographic texture and restrained background detail.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

fetish.definition: Sexual attraction or arousal focused on particular objects, bodily features, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, or sensory qualities that carry special erotic significance, interpreted broadly beyond conventional fetish aesthetics.

levels.0: No added fetish treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This focus is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This focus is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This focus leads the image's appeal and direction.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Relative leadership of the active sensual and fetish axes within one coherent expression.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active distinctive fascination supporting the expression.
choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving the request's core meaning.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal.definition: Added departures from ordinary reality, interpreted broadly across space, scale, causality, materials, and atmosphere, including dreamlike, uncanny, symbolic, and impossible relationships.

levels.0: No added surreal treatment; preserve explicitly requested fantasy and impossible elements.
levels.1: Surreal qualities are a subtle supporting presence.
levels.2: Surreal qualities are clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: Surreal qualities lead the image's main impression and direction; a single coherent relationship may carry this prominence.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.

emphasis_resolution.reason: Effective sensual=1, fetish=0; the higher intensity leads.

authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A complex editorial photograph catches a single photographic moment in a night greenhouse adjoining a specimen archive. A fictional adult woman dressed for an after-hours botanical salon lowers a small flowering begonia toward a wheeled specimen trolley; the supplied portrait guides her visible facial appearance, including softly rounded facial contours, dark rounded almond eyes, a softly shaped nose, and full bowed lips. Her own invented styling has a hime cut: straight black hair with blunt jaw-length sidelocks ending sharply beside both cheeks, a straight eyebrow-level fringe, and a distinct longer back layer falling below her shoulders. A slim black headband arcs across her crown and carries two triangular felt cat ears as a wearable accessory. She wears a garnet satin dress with a square neckline. Two opposed vertical rows of metal eyelets frame the bodice opening, a black cord threads repeatedly across the opening in clear X-shaped crossings and ends in a small tied bow. The knee-length outer skirt flares over a separate gathered ivory petticoat; the petticoat's layered ruffled hem visibly extends below the satin hem and supports its rounded volume. Her left palm supports the pot's saucer while her right fingers steady the terracotta side; the pot stays beside her left thigh, just above the trolley's low shelf, leaving the bodice front readable. Her feet rest on the level aisle, her torso stays comfortably upright, and she turns her face toward the camera with a quiet, inviting expression. A dry pressed leaf on an archival sheet lies on the trolley near the living plant. Glass-front storage shelves recede behind her, roof trusses frame the dark night sky, and broad greenhouse leaves occupy the far edge. A warm task lamp gives the face and satin gentle lustre against cool teal archive light. An eye-level, head-to-toe vertical composition keeps her facial appearance, separated hair lengths, headband construction, lacing, and both skirt layers readable, with natural photographic texture and restrained background detail.
